about: CHAIN dorestad_834: the four summers of the fleet at Dorestad, 834 to 837 (the spine's thread dorestad_falls, its first part). Fourteen cards: ten steps and four endings (the bank holds: history changed; the tribute of 837: what happened; the house gone up the river to Daventre; the storehouse in ashes). Words: Data/writing/chain_dorestad_834.json. Page: Design/content/chains/dorestad_834.md. Written 6 Oct 2026; a draft for the user to overwrite. Flags: ch_dorestad_834_<n> for the steps, the road flags _road_wall, _wall_1, _wall_2, _road_flight, _burned, the spine's df_warned, df_buried and df_moved, and the endings ch_dorestad_834_end_wall, _end_tribute, _end_flight, _end_ashes. History changed: changed_dorestad_834_warned, changed_dorestad_837.

cards.note: Step 1, the start (drawn in the delta, April to June 834). A coast fisherman has seen a fleet of Danes in Frisia. Sources: Annales Bertiniani 834 (a fleet of Danes came into Frisia and laid waste a part of it, and from there came by Utrecht to Dorestad); the coast watch ordered by Charles from 800 and let go while the emperor's sons held him, 833 to 1 March 834 (Design/content/realms/frisia_lotharingia.md: 'the coast guard stops'; the lapse itself is the realm file's reading (?)). The month of the raid is not recorded (?): the game puts it between Pentecost and Lammas. The fisherman is invented and unnamed. Sets ch_dorestad_834_1; _warn if the word is carried; _count if the ships were asked after.

cards.title: Sails in Frisia
cards.intention: A fisherman from the outer coast has rowed two days to sell nothing. He has seen a fleet of the Danes come in among the islands, and smoke behind it.

cards.note: Step 2 (Dorestad, scheduled 1, 3 or 6 days after step 1). Who believes a warning. Sources: Dorestad has no wall or rampart and no count is named there, only the king's agents, 'procuratores rei publicae' (dossiers/dorestad.md); the upper church of Saint Martin (charter of 8 June 777); the emperor put down by his sons in 833 and restored on 1 March 834, Lothar still in arms that summer (Annales Bertiniani 833-834). Cast: cast.thiadbod's son Thiadlef (places/dorestad.json, dorestad.thiadlef: 'has buried silver twice and dug it up once'); the agent and the priest are invented and unnamed. Sets ch_dorestad_834_2; the spine's df_warned; _believed with changed_dorestad_834_warned when the dams take the word; _church; _profit.

cards.title: A fisherman's story
cards.intention: An hour's walk of open bank, a storehouse on every dam, and not so much as a ditch between the river and the richest market in the north. The dams are busy with the summer.

options.note: outcome: chain_dorestad_834.s02.out_church (costs nothing; the plate and the people with no boat go inland)

cards.note: Step 3 (Dorestad, five days after step 2): the eve of the first sack. Sources: Annales Bertiniani 834: the fleet came by Utrecht (per Vetus Treiectum) to the emporium called Dorestad and plundered everything; some of the people were killed, some carried off, and a part of the place burned (our rendering); Annales Xantenses 834. The choice is the place file's beat (places/dorestad.json, story dorestad.river_leaves: load and run up the Lek, put the silver in the ground, or stay with the storehouse). The graves at De Heul are a site of the place file. No burnt layer was found by the diggers (dossiers/dorestad.md): how much burned is not known (?). Reads sw_ran_blades (chain sword_smuggle) and changed_dorestad_dane_yard (chain house_new_ship). Sets ch_dorestad_834_3; _ran_834; the spine's df_buried with _buried, and _saw; _stood.

cards.note: Step 4 (Dorestad, eight days after step 3; also drawn there from July 834 through 835 for a house that was away: the second way into the chain). After the first sack. Sources: Annales Bertiniani 834 (killed, carried off, burned in part); the place file's beat for 834-848 (plate and cloth sold cheap by men who do not say where they got them; a widow selling a dam head; survivors asking after kin sold at Sliesthorp); the spine's hook at Sliesthorp (men in the harbour sell Dorestad cloth and Dorestad people). Rijswijk with its church is a neighbour village (charter of 777, dossiers/dorestad.md). Thiadlef's daughter Hildswith is invented (Hild- + -swith, as in Aldswith). Sets ch_dorestad_834_4; _seek; _plate; and the timer for the girl at Sliesthorp.

cards.note: Step 5, a turn (Sliesthorp, drawn 834 to 836 for anyone past step 4). Dorestad's cloth and Dorestad's people on King Horik's landing. Sources: Horik's envoys told the emperor in 836 that the king had no part in the raids, and complained of envoys of his killed near Cologne (Annales Bertiniani 836; the day and place of the assembly not checked tonight (?)); in 838 he said he had taken and killed the pirate chiefs (Annales Bertiniani 838); merchants of Dorestad at Sliaswich (Rimbert, Vita Anskarii 24); a Christian captive seen for sale at Sliaswich and ransomed (Vita Rimberti 18: LATER, about 870-888). Silver passes by weight (Hedeby's own coin from about 825 is rare). The dealer Ulf and the king's man are invented; no price for a ransom is recorded: 180 d is the game's (goods_793.json has a captive at 48 d; a rich man's daughter is another matter). Sets ch_dorestad_834_5; _ransomed with the girl as a passenger for Dorestad; _knows.

cards.note: Step 7 (Dorestad, drawn from March 835 to March 836): the second summer, and the choice of a road. Sources: Annales Bertiniani 835: the Northmen fell on Dorestad again and laid it waste; the emperor, angered, came to Aachen and set guards along the coasts (our rendering; wording from memory (?)); Annales Xantenses 835. Dorestad never had a wall (dossiers/dorestad.md): the bank and ditch proposed here are ours, fifty years before the ring forts of the Zeeland coast (about 880-890: LATER). Daventre: Lebuin's church of about 770 and a landing on the IJssel (dossiers/daventre.md). Reads changed_dorestad_fellowship (chain house_rival). Sets ch_dorestad_834_7 and one road: _road_wall with _wall_1, or _road_flight, or neither.

cards.note: Step 9, optional (at sea, May to August 836). The fleet of the third summer seen standing in for the Maas. Sources: Annales Fuldenses 836: the Northmen burned Antwerp, and likewise Witla, the emporium by the mouth of the Maas, and took tribute of the Frisians; Annales Bertiniani 836 has Dorestad and Frisia laid waste again (realms/frisia_lotharingia.md notes which annal has which). Selling food to a fleet is ours; no law against it is known before the capitularies on arms (?). The Dane in the straggler is invented. Sources: Annales Bertiniani 836 (Dorestad and Frisia again); Annales Fuldenses 836 (Antwerp and Witla burned); the realm file's summary of how houses lived through it ('stock kept short, silver buried, and the careful houses moving up the river': SCHEMAS.md, war delta_834). The gate, the watch-house and the twelve watchmen are ours. cards.note: ENDING: the bank holds, HISTORY CHANGED (Dorestad, drawn from June 837 through 838, when the second share was paid). Flags ch_dorestad_834_end_wall, changed_dorestad_837, unlock_work_dorestad_wall; a cost that lasts, ch_dorestad_834_watch_due (the house owes the watch a man and his bread every summer). Grand rewards: unlock_charter_dorestad, or unlock_title_doomsman_dorestad, or both on the hard road (the warning brought and the emperor's leave had). What really happened: on 17 June 837 the Northmen took Walcheren, killed Count Eggihard and Hemming, Halfdan's son, took tribute there, and came on to Dorestad and took tribute in the same way; the emperor gave up his journey to Rome and hurried to Nijmegen, the fleet withdrew on hearing of it, and his inquiry found the coast lost partly because it could not be held and partly because some would not obey (Annales Bertiniani 837; the names and the day are Annales Fuldenses 837). The freedom from the tenth is the more striking for the emperor's own rule of 828 that his merchants pay toll nowhere except at Quentovic, Dorestad and the Clusae (Praeceptum negotiatorum, Formulae imperiales 37). The seat among those who find judgment is the count's court of chain house_debt. The emperor is spoken of, not met.

cards.note: ENDING: the tribute of 837, WHAT REALLY HAPPENED (Dorestad, drawn from June 837 through 838, for a house that neither finished the bank, nor left, nor burned). Flag ch_dorestad_834_end_tribute. Grand rewards, one by the option: unlock_work_dorestad_jetty (a dam head pledged for the silver advanced), unlock_factor_sliesthorp (the dealer who spoke between), unlock_kin_thiadlef (a betrothal between the houses), unlock_pilot_lek (four summers of running the Lek by night). Sources: Annales Bertiniani 837: the Northmen fell on Walcheren, killed many and plundered more, stayed a while, took such tribute as they chose, and came with the same fury to Dorestad and took tribute in the same way; the emperor, hearing it, gave up his journey to Rome and came to the fort at Nijmegen near Dorestad; they withdrew; his inquiry laid it partly to what could not be done and partly to the disobedience of some, and he ordered a fleet built (our rendering); Annales Fuldenses 837 for Eggihard, Hemming and 17 June. How the tribute was raised and how much it was are not recorded (?). The chain thread_02 tells Walcheren and the inquiry. The chief is invented and unnamed.

cards.note: ENDING: up the river (Daventre, drawn from June 837 through 838, for a house that moved). Flags ch_dorestad_834_end_flight and the spine's df_moved; a cost that lasts, ch_dorestad_834_left_early (the bank at Dorestad remembers who went first). Grand rewards: unlock_plot_daventre, or unlock_factor_daventre, or the plot with unlock_partner_thiadlef for a house Thiadlef has cause to follow. Sources: the news is Annales Bertiniani 837; Daventre is where Dorestad's trade goes in the end, 'new plots on the IJssel, old Dorestad names on them' (the spine's hook, from 863): to go in 837 is a lifetime early, which is a private change and not one of the annals'. Lebuin's church there (Altfrid's Life of Liudger; dossiers/daventre.md). The man who paces out plots for the church is invented; whose the ground was in 837 is not recorded (?).

steward.note: the man who paces out ground by the church of Lebuin; invented, unnamed

skipper.note: a Dorestad skipper with the news; invented, unnamed

cards.title: A new river
cards.intention: Your looms and scales stand under a hired roof on the IJssel. A boat from the Rhine ties up beside yours and her skipper tells the bank what this summer cost Dorestad.

options.label: Sell the stock while it is dear and take ground of your own by the church
options.note: outcome: chain_dorestad_834.end_flight.out_plot

options.label: Keep the house afloat: sell dear, and leave a sworn man here with the scales and a hired roof
options.note: outcome: chain_dorestad_834.end_flight.out_factor

options.label: Take two plots side by side, and send the boat back down for Thiadlef's household
options.note: outcome: chain_dorestad_834.end_flight.out_fetch (the hard road: only for the house that stood beside him or brought his daughter home; nobody says who went first when both went)

memory.fetch: brought Thiadlef's house up the river

cards.note: ENDING: the storehouse in ashes (Dorestad, drawn from June 837 through 838, for the house whose full store burned). Flags ch_dorestad_834_end_ashes; the spine's df_buried is cleared (the chest is dug up). Grand rewards: unlock_work_dorestad_jetty (the widow's dam head), with a cost that lasts, ch_dorestad_834_bought_cheap; or unlock_partner_thiadlef; or unlock_heirloom_dorestad_scales. Sources: the tribute of 837 (Annales Bertiniani 837); the place file's beat (a widow selling a dam head; houses mended between raids); the harbour dams were built out and mended all through these years and stayed in use to about 875 (dossiers/dorestad.md); lead and bronze scale weights are common finds on the dams (the dossier's digs; the pan balance as a merchant's mark (?)). The widow is the widow of step 4.
cards.when: moored and port.id = dorestad and flag.ch_dorestad_834_burned and not flag.ch_dorestad_834_wall_2 and not flag.ch_dorestad_834_end_ashes and ((year = 837 and month >= 6) or year = 838)

widow.note: the widow with a dam head to sell; invented, unnamed

cards.title: What is in the ground
cards.intention: The posts of your storehouse stand black to the height of a man. This summer the fleet took silver instead of fire, and the houses that kept their stock short have kept their roofs as well.

options.label: Dig up the chest and buy the widow's dam head at the price she is frightened enough to take
options.note: outcome: chain_dorestad_834.end_ashes.out_head (the chest less her price: 750 d; a berth of your own at the head; the bank remembers the price)

options.label: Dig up the chest and build one roof with Thiadlef on his dam: two marks on one door
options.note: outcome: chain_dorestad_834.end_ashes.out_yard

options.label: Dig up the chest, rake the ashes for the house's scales and its stick of names, and build small
options.note: outcome: chain_dorestad_834.end_ashes.out_scales (the whole chest, 900 d, and the pans and weights that went through the fire: a thing an heir keeps)

memory.head: bought a widow's dam head cheap after the fire
memory.scales: raked his scales out of the ashes
